hypothesis: User-specified: a sufficiently large predicted RMSF decrease at any peptide position nominates an antigen candidate.
study_type: New exploratory hypothesis after prior analyses; not an independent prospective validation.
primary_score: max over all9 peptide positions of parent_predicted_RMSF minus mutant_predicted_RMSF, Angstrom. Keep sign, no position exclusions.
candidate_scope: All7TCR contexts,171 nonparent single substitutions each,1197 total. Same parent backbone and model as original archive.
primary_mode: Zero functional calibration labels; top30 candidates per context.
threshold: No physically validated absolute Angstrom threshold. Export full threshold-vs-selected-count/hit-rate curve and D>0 descriptive gate; do not pick best threshold from outcomes.
score_ties: Randomly exchangeable exact-score ties; report expected top-k hits. A lexical ordering is exported solely as a concrete deterministic list.
label_endpoint: Source normalized highest-dose4-1BB CD8 response, hit>=0.3; operational recognition retention, not KD or above-parent improvement.
secondary_endpoint: Relative top-decile response retrieval, same selections; Spearman over continuous original functional response.
diagnostics: Second-largest decrease across9 sites, never replace primary by better result.
Archive maximum site,parent RMSF,mutated-site identity, parent4.5A contacts toTCR/HLA; no phenotype-dependent region masks.
Mutation-position-matched random expected yield: same count at each mutated peptide position as the selected list; tests within-position amino-acid discrimination.
optional_observed_label_context: Compare max-drop selection to old sequence/BLOSUM policies on identical remaining pools after18 common observed candidates,20 old fixed seeds. Distinguish this from primary zero-label mode; do not call observation budgets equal to zero-label experiment.
